chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The most serious sin is that which the doer considers light.
ai.seo_question: What makes a sin the most serious according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies the gravest sins as those underestimated by their perpetrators, highlighting how spiritual heedlessness (ghaflah) distorts moral perception. This principle underscores the Shia scholarly view that the severity of a sin is not merely objective but is significantly amplified by the sinner's subjective dismissal of its weight, leading to a deeper spiritual decay.
